description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Earth 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Gaia Break Mode] and [Colossal Fist Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Earth Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Earth 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: Gaia Break Mode
description.text: Earth abilities deal 10/20/30/40/50% more damage if the target's Earth weakness is 20/30/40/50/60%+, removed if user hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: Colossal Fist Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Colossal Fist after using Wolf's Bite or Colossal Arm
